reuse.why: Extends the existing applyWeekendRule/WeekendRule and applyWeekendRuleToDay for holidays, but the daily-skip rule is not folded into that abstraction and is instead re-expressed with isNonWorkingDay at each consumer.

duplication.why: The 'daily + skipWeekend => drop non-working days' rule is written separately in getNextDate (getNextDailyDateSkippingWeekends), getUpcomingDates (its own loop with its own 7*7-day guard), getDatesInRange, and as frequency !== 'daily' checks in schedule-template.

placement.why: isNonWorkingDay, the holiday-aware shift and the daily lookup live in shared/schedules.ts, and the new handler sits with its siblings in server/schedules/app.ts; only the daily dispatch leaks into server-side callers.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps (daily skip, range handler, holidays, MM-DD holidays) plus tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: Holiday matching is centralised in isNonWorkingDay, but the daily rule is enforced by four independent branches with different look-ahead limits, and schedule-template now overloads noSkipWeekend and skipWeekend with frequency checks, so changing the daily rule needs edits in several places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts branch on frequency === 'daily' and filter with isNonWorkingDay themselves instead of going through applyWeekendRule/a shared rule; schedule-template computes skipWeekend && frequency !== 'daily' at the call site.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-skip search in getUpcomingDates (for-loop with break and 49-day guard) reshapes getNextDailyDateSkippingWeekends (take-limited find) rather than sharing it; getDatesInRange's isDaily/continue branch restates the same rule in a third shape.

abstraction_drift.where: holidays added to WeekendRule/getDateWithSkippedWeekend; a daily special-case branch added inside shared getNextDate; getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template's createScheduleList each decide the daily case themselves.
